scope:
Mass Spectrometry: Total Protein Abundances

HAP1 WT and SPPL3−/− were prepared and analyzed as described previously.

First, we employed a proteomics approach to exclude different protein expressions of the targeted proteins which could bias analysis of antibody binding (Figure S5A,B). Using mass spectrometry, we found that only one protein (glutathione S‐transferase mu 3 [GSTM3]) was significantly differentially expressed between HAP1 WT and SPPL3−/− cell lines.
